description: Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Highway Reference Points (HRP) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Highway Reference Point is a visibly recognizable feature used to describe and identify a point on the Highway (i.e., a reference point abstracted on the Highway and defined by a physical landmark such as an intersection). HRP Landmarks are used in order to provide reference points relating to inventory item data. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are HRP, MOT, highway reference point, landmark, Government information. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, KML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
